newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says Italy, Spain dairy farmers to pay fines.
newsitem.headline: EU says Italy, Spain dairy farmers to pay fines.

text.p: Italian and Spanish dairy farmers will pay "super levy" fines for exceeding milk production quotas in 1995/96, a Commission spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman said Italian and Spanish farmers must pay fines totalling 170 million and 40 million Ecus respectively by January 31.
"No further concessions will be made," the spokesman said, noting the payment deadline had been extended from end-December.
Italian and Spanish farmers exceeded production quotas by 470,000 and 121,000 tonnes respectively out of total national annual quotas of 11 million and five million tonnes.
The fines are payable by farmers and cannot be passed onto milk processors, the spokesman added.
On Friday, the Italian government approved a draft law to compensate Italian dairy farmers.
But farmers, staging a second day of protests in northern Italy, said the compensation was insufficient.
